SELECT BD.BOOKSET_DATE AS booksetDate, M.ACCT_STANDARD AS acctStandard, B.BOOK_DATE AS bookDate, B.HAPPEN_DATE AS happenDate, M.STANDARD_CCY AS standardCcy, A.TRADE_ID AS tradeid, A.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetid, A.RECORD_TYPE AS recordtype, A.OFFSET_FLAG AS offsetflag, A.BUSI_ID AS busiid, A.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE AS busidetailtype, A.BUSI_TYPE AS busitype, A.BOOK_ID AS bookid, A.BOOK_TYPE AS booktype, A.BOOK_REMARK AS bookremark, A.P_TRADE_ID AS ptradeid, A.INV_AIM AS invaim FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO D INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET M ON D.BOOKSET_ID = M.BOOKSET_ID INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE BD ON BD.BOOKSET_ID = M.BOOKSET_ID INNER JOIN BOK_MATCH_RLAT E ON (D.TASK_ID = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR D.TASK_ID IS NULL) AND NVL(D.TASK_ID, #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) = E.SOURCE AND E.MATCH_TYPE = '01' AND (E.ACCT_STANDARD = M.ACCT_STANDARD OR E.ACCT_STANDARD = 'ALL') INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING B ON D.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID
AND D.HAPPEN_DATE = B.HAPPEN_DATE AND D.BOOK_DATE >= B.BOOK_DATE INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING_DETAIL B2 ON B2.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND B2.BUSI_TYPE = E.TARGET AND B2.BUSI_NO = B.BUSI_NO and B2.busi_table =B.busi_table INNER JOIN TRD_VOUCH_DEAL A ON B.BUSI_NO = A.TRADE_ID AND B2.BUSI_TYPE = A.BUSI_TYPE AND B.BOOK_DATE = A.BOOK_DATE WHERE D.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND D.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND D.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND D.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND D.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND D.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET} AND A.ACCOUNT_ORDER = #{accountOder} ORDER BY M.START_DATE,A.TRADE_ID

SELECT DETAIL.TRADE_ID tradeId, DETAIL.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, DETAIL.BRANCH branch, DETAIL.SUBJECT_NO subjectNo, DETAIL.SUBJECT_NAME subjectName, DETAIL.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO_TAIL detailSubjectNoTail, DETAIL_SUBNAME_TAIL detailSubnameTail, DETAIL.O_HAPPEN_AMT oHappenAmt, DETAIL.CD_FLAG cdFlag, DETAIL.CCY ccy, DETAIL.HAPPEN_NUMBER happenNumber, DETAIL.BOK_DETAIL_ID bokDetailId, DETAIL.BUSI_ID busiId, DETAIL.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE busiDetailType, DETAIL.INV_AIM invAim, DETAIL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, SB.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE baseSubjectNature, DETAIL.b_Happen_Amt bHappenAmt, SB.BAL_FLAG balFlag, SB.SUBJECT_TYPE subjectType FROM TRD_VOUCH_DEAL_DETAIL DETAIL INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET C ON DETAIL.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID INNER JOIN BOK_SUBJECT SB ON C.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = SB.BOOKSET_ID AND DETAIL.SUBJECT_NO = SB.SUBJECT_NO
